### IgBlast Alignement

Use Change-O IgBlast to align processed reads against IMGT IG and TR VDJC references


```{bash,eval=F}
# in a environment : conda activate pRESTO

LongRead_dir="PATH/Processed_3rdRun/"

cd ${LongRead_dir}

mkdir Immcantation/7_IgBlast

#List file 
files=`cat "${LongRead_dir}sampleId_batch1_run3_SMRTbellCRC.txt"`


for file in $files; do

  echo $file


## IgBlast 1.22 alignment - IG

echo "Runing AssignGenes.py igblast 1.22 against IMGT database - For IG"

# Input file WITHOUT any collapse duplicate but on Maskqual.fastq file
## IgBlast alignment
AssignGenes.py igblast -s "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/4_TrimPrimerAndBarcode/${file}_only_insert_fastp_processed.reads.fastq" -b PATH/igblast --organism human --loci ig --format blast --outname "${file}_ig" --outdir "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/7_IgBlast/" --nproc 26 > "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/pipeline_log/${file}_ChangeO_and_PostProcess_perf.log" 2>&1

## Convert IgBlast result in a database
echo "Runing MakeDb.py igblast to convert IgBlast IG result in a database"
MakeDb.py igblast -i "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/7_IgBlast/${file}_ig_igblast.fmt7" -s "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/7_IgBlast/${file}_only_insert_fastp_processed.reads.fasta" -r PATH/germlines/imgt/human/vdj PATH/germlines/imgt/human/constant --extended --log "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/7_IgBlast/${file}_igblast_ig.log" --outdir "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/7_IgBlast/" >> "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/pipeline_log/${file}_ChangeO_and_PostProcess_perf.log" 2>&1

## Convert IgBlast log in a table to analyze in R
echo "Runing ParseLog.py on IgBlast IG log to identify reasons why reads fail to identify a clone"
ParseLog.py -l "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/7_IgBlast/${file}_igblast_ig.log" -f ID V_CALL D_CALL J_CALL PRODUCTIVE ERROR >> "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/pipeline_log/${file}_Immcantation_perf.log" 2>&1



## IgBlast 1.22 alignment - TR

echo "Runing AssignGenes.py igblast 1.22 against IMGT database - For TR"

# Input file WITHOUT any collapse duplicate but on Maskqual.fastq file
## IgBlast alignment
AssignGenes.py igblast -s "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/4_TrimPrimerAndBarcode/${file}_only_insert_fastp_processed.reads.fastq" -b PATH/igblast --organism human --loci tr --format blast --outname "${file}_tr" --outdir "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/7_IgBlast/" --nproc 26 >> "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/pipeline_log/${file}_ChangeO_and_PostProcess_perf.log" 2>&1

## Convert IgBlast result in a database
```

### Post-alignment processing 

All reads were aligned against IMGT referece with IgBlast 2 times, one to create an Ig DB, one to create a TR DB.

Verify that reads are either assigned to IG or TR but not both ... If it is not the case, choose how to decide which chain is the most plausible or just filter.

Post process IgBlast alignment and create a log file.

#### Quality filters 

```{r,eval=FALSE}
##Un comment it to save

dir.create(paste0(ImmcantationFolder,"8_PostIgBlastFilter"))

```


```{r,eval=FALSE}

# Open a file connection for writing a log file ##un comment if needed
sink(paste0("PATH/Processed_3rdRun/Immcantation/","pipeline_log/","R_LongReads_IgBlast_Alignment_QualityFilter.log"), append = FALSE, type = c("output"))

  print("Start processing of Long read aligned with IgBlast")
  Sys.time()
  
  #add space in the log
  print("\n")
  print("\n")


for(file in FileID){
  
  print(file)
  
  # Do not need to adapt from here - path of R1 after clustering and renaming
  file_path <- paste0(ImmcantationFolder,"7_IgBlast/",file)
  
  # Load airr from IgBlast alignment - Not collapsed file ...
  DB_IG <- read_rearrangement(paste0(file_path,"_ig_igblast_db-pass.tsv"))
  DB_TR <- read_rearrangement(paste0(file_path,"_tr_igblast_db-pass.tsv"))
  
  
  # Compute total number of reads aligned to Ig and to TR from input
  ## Retrieve the number of seq used in input of MiXCR for the pipeline log
  ## USe the bash command wc -l within R
  
  Input <- paste0("PATH/Processed_3rdRun/Immcantation/4_TrimPrimerAndBarcode/",file,"_only_insert_fastp_processed.reads.fastq")
  Input <- system(paste("wc -l", shQuote(Input)), intern = TRUE)
  Input <- as.numeric(unlist(base::strsplit(Input,split = " "))[[1]] )
  Input <- Input/4 #the command above retrieve the number of line in fastq. Divide by 4 to get the number of seq
  print(paste0("Reads in input for IgBlast (Insert only) : ",Input))

  ## Reads aligned to Ig with IgBlast
  Num <- nrow(DB_IG)
  Prop <- round((Num/Input)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Reads aligned to Ig with IgBlast : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  ## Reads aligned to TR with IgBlast
  Num <- nrow(DB_TR)
  Prop <- round((Num/Input)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Reads aligned to TR with IgBlast : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  

  # Reads should be aligned in reverse complement orientation only
  ## orientation in forward suggest an incorrect pre-processing of reads and thus an incorrect SB/UMI attribution
  ### Number of seq with incorrect Ig alignment orientation
  Num <- sum(!(DB_IG$rev_comp))
  PropIg <- round((Num/nrow(DB_IG))*100,2)
  print(paste0("Reads aligned to Ig in Incorrect orientation (forward) : ",Num," (",PropIg," %Ig)"))

  ### Number of seq with incorrect TR alignment orientation
  Num <- sum(!(DB_TR$rev_comp))
  PropTR <- round((Num/nrow(DB_TR))*100,2)
  print(paste0("Reads aligned to TR in Incorrect orientation (forward) : ",Num," (",PropTR," %TR)"))
  

  # Filter only reads aligned in right orientation (revComp) and only for Ig or Tr
  DB_IG <- DB_IG[DB_IG$rev_comp,]
  DB_TR <- DB_TR[DB_TR$rev_comp,]
  
  # Compute number of reads aligned to both Ig and TR
  if(sum(DB_IG$sequence_id %in% DB_TR$sequence_id)>0){
    DB_IG_Intersect <- DB_IG[DB_IG$sequence_id %in% DB_TR$sequence_id,]
    DB_IG_Intersect <- data.frame(DB_IG_Intersect)
    rownames(DB_IG_Intersect)<-DB_IG_Intersect$sequence_id
    DB_TR_Intersect <- DB_TR[DB_TR$sequence_id %in% DB_IG$sequence_id,]
    DB_TR_Intersect <- data.frame(DB_TR_Intersect)
    rownames(DB_TR_Intersect)<-DB_TR_Intersect$sequence_id
    DB_TR_Intersect <- DB_TR_Intersect[rownames(DB_IG_Intersect),] # check that the order of row for both subset are the same
    
    ## check v score of Ig and Tr alignment (top score), same for j
    TopVscore <- ifelse(DB_IG_Intersect$v_score < DB_TR_Intersect$v_score,
           yes = "V-TR",
           no = ifelse(DB_IG_Intersect$v_score == DB_TR_Intersect$v_score,
                       yes ="V-ambiguous" ,
                       no = "V-IG"))
    TopJscore <- ifelse(DB_IG_Intersect$j_score < DB_TR_Intersect$j_score,
           yes = "J-TR",
           no = ifelse(DB_IG_Intersect$j_score == DB_TR_Intersect$j_score,
                       yes ="J-ambiguous" ,
                       no = "J-IG"))
    ## Same for v/j_support. Lower value means better probability of correct match
    ## check v score of Ig and Tr alignment (top score), same for j
    LowVsupport <- ifelse(DB_IG_Intersect$v_support > DB_TR_Intersect$v_support,
           yes = "Vsupport-TR",
           no = ifelse(DB_IG_Intersect$v_support == DB_TR_Intersect$v_support,
                       yes ="Vsupport-ambiguous" ,
                       no = "Vsupport-IG"))
    LowJsupport <- ifelse(DB_IG_Intersect$j_support > DB_TR_Intersect$j_support,
           yes = "Jsupport-TR",
           no = ifelse(DB_IG_Intersect$j_support == DB_TR_Intersect$j_support,
                       yes ="Jsupport-ambiguous" ,
                       no = "Jsupport-IG"))
    
    
    ## Check Ig and Tr alignement length
    ## SeqLen could be commented to keep memory/time
    IGseq_len <- stri_count(DB_IG_Intersect[["sequence_alignment"]],regex="[^-.N]")
    TRseq_len <- stri_count(DB_TR_Intersect[["sequence_alignment"]],regex="[^-.N]")
    TopSeqLen <- ifelse(IGseq_len < TRseq_len,
           yes = "SeqLen-TR",
           no = ifelse(IGseq_len == TRseq_len,
                       yes ="SeqLen-ambiguous" ,
                       no = "SeqLen-IG"))
    
    
    
    Ig_Or_Tr_df <- data.frame(TopVscore=TopVscore,
                              TopJscore=TopJscore,
                              TopSeqLen=TopSeqLen,
                              LowVsupport=LowVsupport,
                              LowJsupport=LowJsupport,
                              IgProd=ifelse(DB_IG_Intersect$productive,yes ="IG-Prod" ,no = "IG-NotProd"),
                              IgInFrame=ifelse(DB_IG_Intersect$vj_in_frame,yes = "IG-InFrame",no = "IG-NotInFrame"),
                              TrProd=ifelse(DB_TR_Intersect$productive,yes ="TR-Prod",no = "TR-NotProd"),
                              TrInFrame=ifelse(DB_TR_Intersect$vj_in_frame,yes ="TR-InFrame",no = "TR-NotInFrame"))
    
    
    # Comment : these were approaches in optimization
    # Ig_Or_Tr_df$Collapse <-apply(Ig_Or_Tr_df,1,paste,collapse="_")
    # Ig_Or_Tr_df$Collapse_only3Top <-paste(Ig_Or_Tr_df$TopVscore,Ig_Or_Tr_df$TopJscore,Ig_Or_Tr_df$TopSeqLen,sep  = "_")
    # Ig_Or_Tr_df$Collapse_only5Top <-paste(Ig_Or_Tr_df$TopVscore,Ig_Or_Tr_df$LowVsupport,Ig_Or_Tr_df$TopJscore,Ig_Or_Tr_df$LowJsupport,Ig_Or_Tr_df$TopSeqLen,sep  = "_")
    
    # final approach retained : consider top v/j score and lowest (best) v/j support (E-value) between Ig and Tr.
    ## A correct Ig (resp Tr) should have top v, top j, top v support, top j support
    ## ie : Ig : "V-IG_Vsupport-IG_J-IG_Jsupport-IG"; Tr : "V-TR_Vsupport-TR_J-TR_Jsupport-TR"
    Ig_Or_Tr_df$Collapse_only4Top <-paste(Ig_Or_Tr_df$TopVscore,Ig_Or_Tr_df$LowVsupport,Ig_Or_Tr_df$TopJscore,Ig_Or_Tr_df$LowJsupport,sep  = "_")
    
    # Print nb of correct Ambiguous / correct IG / correct TR
    ## Total read with both alignment
    Num <- nrow(Ig_Or_Tr_df)
    PropIg <- round((Num/nrow(DB_IG))*100,2)
    PropTR <- round((Num/nrow(DB_TR))*100,2)
    print(paste0("Reads aligned to TR as well as Ig with IgBlast : ",Num," (",PropIg," %Ig, ",PropTR, " %TR)"))
    
    ## Ambiguous vs saved read
    AmbiguousTable <- table(Ig_Or_Tr_df$Collapse_only4Top)
    NumIg <- AmbiguousTable[["V-IG_Vsupport-IG_J-IG_Jsupport-IG"]]
    NumTr <- AmbiguousTable[["V-TR_Vsupport-TR_J-TR_Jsupport-TR"]]
    NumAmbig <- sum(AmbiguousTable)-NumIg-NumTr
    PropIg <- round((NumIg/sum(AmbiguousTable))*100,2)
    PropTR <- round((NumTr/sum(AmbiguousTable))*100,2)
    PropAmbig <- round((NumAmbig/sum(AmbiguousTable))*100,2)

    print(paste0("Reads aligned to TR as well as Ig with IgBlast - TRUE Ig : ",NumIg," (",PropIg,"%)"))
    print(paste0("Reads aligned to TR as well as Ig with IgBlast - TRUE Tr : ",NumTr," (",PropTR,"%)"))
    print(paste0("Reads aligned to TR as well as Ig with IgBlast - Ambiguous Ig-Tr : ",NumAmbig," (",PropAmbig,"%)"))
    
    #DB_intersecet_retained
    id_seq_true_ig <- DB_IG_Intersect$sequence_id[Ig_Or_Tr_df$Collapse_only4Top=="V-IG_Vsupport-IG_J-IG_Jsupport-IG"]
    id_seq_true_tr <- DB_TR_Intersect$sequence_id[Ig_Or_Tr_df$Collapse_only4Top=="V-TR_Vsupport-TR_J-TR_Jsupport-TR"]

    DB_intersect_retained <- rbind(DB_IG[DB_IG$sequence_id %in% id_seq_true_ig,],
                                    DB_TR[DB_TR$sequence_id %in% id_seq_true_tr,])
    
    # Concatenate DB_IG and DB_TR and DB_intersect_retained
    ## For reads both Ig and Tr aligned, select top V score aligned to conclude as Ig or Tr. Remove ambiguous 
    airr <- rbind(DB_IG[DB_IG$sequence_id %in% base::setdiff(DB_IG$sequence_id, DB_TR$sequence_id),], #Ig specific (not aligned to TR)
                  DB_TR[DB_TR$sequence_id %in% base::setdiff(DB_TR$sequence_id,DB_IG$sequence_id),], #Tr specific (not aligned to Ig)
                  DB_intersect_retained)
    
  }else{
    print(paste0("Reads aligned to TR as well as Ig with IgBlast : ","0"," (","0"," %Ig, ","0", " %TR)"))
    print(paste0("Reads aligned to TR as well as Ig with IgBlast - TRUE Ig : ","NA"," (","NA","%)"))
    print(paste0("Reads aligned to TR as well as Ig with IgBlast - TRUE Tr : ","NA"," (","NA","%)"))
    print(paste0("Reads aligned to TR as well as Ig with IgBlast - Ambiguous Ig-Tr : ","NA"," (","NA","%)"))
    # Concatenate DB_IG and DB_TR.
    airr <- rbind(DB_IG,DB_TR)
  }
  
  
  Num <- nrow(airr)
  print(paste0("Sequences kept after filtering incorrect and ambiguous alignment : ",Num))
  
  
  # **Identify Sequences with a Min length of 200 nt**
  ### Identify Short Sequences
  ### Compute sequence alignment length excluding dots and N
  ## Min length 200 nt
  input_seq_len <- stri_count(airr[["sequence"]],regex="[^-.N]")
  summary_length <- summary(input_seq_len)
  
  print("Long read length in input to IgBlast (only informative positions)")
  print(summary_length)

  ## Plot the sequence length distribution
  Plot <- ggplot(data.frame(Length = input_seq_len), aes(x = Length)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "blue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = paste("Long read length in input to IgBlast (gap and N excluded)"), x = "Input Sequence Length", y = "Frequency") +
    # scale_y_log10()+
     geom_vline(xintercept = summary_length["Mean"], linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = summary_length["Mean"], y = 0, label = paste("Average Length:\n", round(summary_length["Mean"], 2)), color = "red", vjust = -2.5,hjust = -0.1)
  
  ##store results
  ggsave(filename = paste0(res_folder,"03_IgBlast/",file,"_Read_length.pdf"),plot = Plot,width = 7,height = 5)


  ## Same for aligned sequence
  seq_len <- stri_count(airr[["sequence_alignment"]],regex="[^-.N]")
  summary_length <- summary(seq_len)

  print("Aligned sequence (VDJ) length (only informative positions)")
  print(summary_length)
  
  ## Plot the sequence length distribution
  Plot <- ggplot(data.frame(Length = seq_len), aes(x = Length)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "blue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = paste("Aligned sequence (VDJ) length (gap and N excluded)"), x = "Aligned Sequence Length", y = "Frequency") +
    # scale_y_log10()+
     geom_vline(xintercept = summary_length["Mean"], linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = summary_length["Mean"], y = 0, label = paste("Average Length:", round(summary_length["Mean"], 2)), color = "red", vjust = -0.5,hjust = 0.5)+
    geom_vline(xintercept = 200, linetype = "dotted", color = "blue", size = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = 200, y = Inf, label = "Quality filter\nLong seq", color = "blue", vjust = +2.5,hjust = +1)
  
  ##store results
  ggsave(filename = paste0(res_folder,"03_IgBlast/",file,"_AlignedSeq_VDJ_length.pdf"),plot = Plot,width = 7,height = 5)
  
  ##create a filter
  long_seq <- seq_len >= 200
  
  ##store results
  print("Filter long aligned informative length >= 200")
  print(table(long_seq))
  print(round((table(long_seq)/sum(table(long_seq)))*100,2))

  
  # **Identify disagreements between the VDJC IgBLAST alignment**
  ## Identify sequences with a disagreements between the V/J gene alignment and and the C gene IgBLAST alignment
  ### Identify sequences with no C_call identify by IgBlast and remove them or tag chain and isotype as chain_NA
  ## Keep reads with coherent gene, primer and isotype calls 

  ## Compute disagreement
  V_disagree_locus <-ifelse(getLocus(airr[["v_call"]]) == airr[["locus"]],yes = "same_locus",no = "V_different_from_locus")
  
  J_disagree_locus <-ifelse(getLocus(airr[["j_call"]]) == airr[["locus"]],yes = "same_locus",no = "J_different_from_locus")
  
  ##replace C_Call NA as paste(locus,NA)
  airr$isotype <- gsub("\\*","",substr(airr[["c_call"]],1,5))
  airr$isotype <- ifelse(test = is.na((airr[["isotype"]])),
                                      yes = paste(airr[["locus"]],"NA",sep = "_"),
                                      no = airr[["isotype"]])
  
  Isotype_disagree_locus <- ifelse(getLocus(airr[["isotype"]]) == airr[["locus"]],yes = "same_locus",no = "C_different_from_locus")
  
  same_locus <- (V_disagree_locus=="same_locus")  & (J_disagree_locus=="same_locus") & (Isotype_disagree_locus=="same_locus")
  
  ##store results
  print("Filter sequence with inconsistent VDJ call (e.g. VH and JK)")
  print(table(same_locus))
  print(round((table(same_locus)/sum(table(same_locus)))*100,2))
  print(table(Isotype_disagree_locus,V_disagree_locus))
  print(round(table(Isotype_disagree_locus,V_disagree_locus)/sum(table(Isotype_disagree_locus,V_disagree_locus))*100,2))
  print(table(V_disagree_locus,J_disagree_locus))
  print(round(table(V_disagree_locus,J_disagree_locus)/sum(table(V_disagree_locus,J_disagree_locus))*100,2))
   print(table(Isotype_disagree_locus,J_disagree_locus))
  print(round(table(Isotype_disagree_locus,J_disagree_locus)/sum(table(Isotype_disagree_locus,J_disagree_locus))*100,2))
  
  # **Identify Reads with an Acceptable Number of Ambiguous Nucleotides - Max 10% N**
  ## Identify Reads with an Acceptable Number of Ambiguous Nucleotides
  ## Max 10% N
  num_n <- stri_count(airr[["sequence_alignment"]],fixed="N") 
  
  ## Plot the Num N nucleotide distribution
  Plot <- ggplot(data.frame(num_n = num_n), aes(x = num_n)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "blue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = paste("Number of ambiguous nucleotide per sequence"), x = "Number of N in aligned sequence", y = "Frequency") 
  
  ##store results
  ggsave(filename = paste0(res_folder,"03_IgBlast/",file,"_AlignedSeq_num_N.pdf"),plot = Plot,width = 7,height = 5)
  
  ## Same in ratio
  len <- stri_count(airr[["sequence_alignment"]],regex="[^-.]") # re-compute seq_len with N
  ratio_n <- num_n/len
  
  ## Plot the ratio N nucleotide distribution
  Plot <- ggplot(data.frame(ratio_n = ratio_n), aes(x = ratio_n)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, fill = "blue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = paste("Ratio of ambiguous nucleotide per sequence"), x = "Ratio of N in aligned sequence", y = "Frequency") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.1, linetype = "dotted", color = "blue", size = 1) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = Inf, label = "Quality filter\nLow N", color = "blue", vjust = +2.5,hjust = -0.1)
  
  ##store results
  ggsave(filename = paste0(res_folder,"03_IgBlast/",file,"_AlignedSeq_ratio_N.pdf"),plot = Plot,width = 7,height = 5)

  ##Filter and save table results
  low_n <- ratio_n <= 0.10
  no_n <- ratio_n==0
  
  print("Filter sequence with more than 10% N nucleotide")
  print(table(low_n))
  print(round((table(low_n)/(sum(table(low_n))))*100,2))
  
  print(table(no_n))
  print(round((table(no_n)/sum(table(no_n)))*100,2))
  

  # **Only productive sequences are kept**
  ##If not already filtered, only productive sequences are kept
  prod <- airr[["productive"]]

  print("Filter only productive sequences")
  print(table(prod))
  print(round((table(prod)/sum(table(prod)))*100,2))
  
  # **Identify sequences with junction length multiple of three**
  ### Identify sequences with junction length multiple of three
  ## %% modulo operator
  
  m3 <- airr[["junction_length"]] %% 3 == 0
  
  print("Filter only junction with length modulo 3")
  print(table(m3))
  print(round((table(m3)/sum(table(m3)))*100,2))
  
  
  ### Filter and save repertoire
  
  airr$long_seq <- long_seq
  airr$same_locus <- same_locus
  airr$low_n <- low_n
  airr$m3 <- m3
  
  filter_pass <- long_seq & same_locus & low_n & prod & m3

  print("Sequences kept after quality filter")
  print(table(filter_pass))
  print(round((table(filter_pass)/sum(table(filter_pass)))*100,2))
  
  
  # filter and plot N per chain and proportion
  airr <- airr[filter_pass,!(colnames(airr) %in% c("seqorient","part_r1","tso","polyt"))]
  
 TableChain <- table(airr$locus)
Total <- sum(TableChain)

print(paste0("Total READS identifying clone after quality filter (no deduplication): ",Total))
```

##### Chimeric read filtering 


```{r,eval=F}
# Load a modified version of slideWindowDb to close the cluster at the end when nproc=12 (numeric) ...
## if (stop_cluster & !is.numeric(nproc)) =>>> replaced by : if (stop_cluster). if nproc=12; then the statement was evaluated as False (!is.numeric(nproc)) and the cluster was not stropped ...
#clear the session before running the following script. With 10 cores, it takes aroun 20-30 Go memory per iterations

slideWindowDb_modif <- function(db, sequenceColumn="sequence_alignment",
                          germlineColumn="germline_alignment_d_mask",
                          mutThresh=6, windowSize=10, nproc=1){
    # Hack for visibility of foreach index variables
    i <- NULL
    
    # Check input
    check <- checkColumns(db, c(sequenceColumn, germlineColumn))
    if (check != TRUE) { stop(check) }

    db <- db[,c(sequenceColumn, germlineColumn)]
    # If the user has previously set the cluster and does not wish to reset it
    if(!is.numeric(nproc)){
        stop_cluster <- FALSE
        cluster <- nproc
        nproc <- 0
    } else {
        stop_cluster <- TRUE
    }

    # Ensure that the nproc does not exceed the number of cores/CPUs available
    nproc <- min(nproc, cpuCount())

    # If user wants to parallelize this function and specifies nproc > 1, then
    # initialize and register slave R processes/clusters &
    # export all necessary environment variables, functions and packages.
    if (nproc == 1) {
        # If needed to run on a single core/cpu then, register DoSEQ
        # (needed for 'foreach' in non-parallel mode)
        registerDoSEQ()
    } else {
        cluster_type <- "FORK"
        if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
            cluster_type <- "PSOCK"
        }
        if (nproc != 0) {
            #cluster <- makeCluster(nproc, type="SOCK")
            cluster <- parallel::makeCluster(nproc, type= cluster_type)
        }
        parallel::clusterExport(cluster,
                                    list('db', 'sequenceColumn', 'germlineColumn',
                                         'mutThresh', 'windowSize','slideWindowSeq'),
                                    envir=environment() )
        registerDoParallel(cluster,cores=nproc)
    }

    filter <- unlist(foreach(i=1:nrow(db),
                   .verbose=FALSE, .errorhandling='stop') %dopar% {
                       slideWindowSeq(inputSeq = db[i, sequenceColumn],
                                      germlineSeq = db[i, germlineColumn],
                                      mutThresh = mutThresh,
                                      windowSize = windowSize)
                   })
    if (stop_cluster) {
        parallel::stopCluster(cluster)
    }
    filter

}


library(doParallel)
```

#### IGH membrane or secreted form

Retrieve all reads from IGH locus in the global database after general filters. The reads are in the column sequence and they are already reverse complemented to be in the correct orientation 5'>3' Variable region > Constant region. Create a fasta file with these IGH reads. Then align the IGH reads against IMGT constant genes from CHS or Membrane exons (see script 00_IMGT_Constant_genes_to_align.Rmd for the generation of the fasta file). Check consistency of the alignment (CHS from IGHG3 should be the best alignment for a secreted form of a reads identified as IGHG3 by IgBLAST). Finaly tag the global database with either membrane or secreted form or NA if no alignment was possible. 

For the optimization part, take the reads from NA alignment and visualize why they failed to align against CHS or M (incorrect splicing of the mRNA ? Introns in the cDNA coming from pre-mRNA ? ...). Evaluate if these reads should be filtered out or not.

##### Get IGH reads

First get all IGH reads in a fasta file to align

```{r,eval=FALSE}
# Retrive all IGH reads in a temporary fasta file to align with Blastn

SampleId <- Anonym_table$SpatialVDJ_id

IDmatch <- Anonym_table$SpatialGEX_id
names(IDmatch) <- SampleId

for(file in FileID){
  
  print(file)
  
  # Do not need to adapt from here - path of Igblast quality filtered database
  file_path <- paste0(ImmcantationFolder,"8_PostIgBlastFilter/",file,"_igblast-db_quality_filter-allFilter_germ-pass_chimeric-filter.tsv")
  
  # Load airr 
  airr <- read_rearrangement(file_path)
  
  # subset IGH
  airr <- airr[airr$locus %in% "IGH",]
  
  # Create a fasta file with in the header : 
  ## >
  ## read_id 
  ## | to separate tags
  ## Tag=value
  ## Tag to include : isotype,"v_sequence_start", "v_sequence_end","d_sequence_start","d_sequence_end","j_sequence_start" ,         "j_sequence_end"
  header <- paste0(">",airr$sequence_id)
  header <- paste(header,
                  paste("rev_comp",airr$rev_comp,sep = "="),
                  paste("isotype",airr$isotype,sep = "="),
                  paste("v_sequence_start",airr$v_sequence_start,sep = "="),
                  paste("v_sequence_end",airr$v_sequence_end,sep = "="),
                  paste("d_sequence_start",airr$d_sequence_start,sep = "="),
                  paste("d_sequence_end",airr$d_sequence_end,sep = "="),
                  paste("j_sequence_start",airr$j_sequence_start,sep = "="),
                  paste("j_sequence_end",airr$j_sequence_end,sep = "="),
                  sep = "|")
  seq <- airr$sequence
  fasta <-paste(header,seq,sep = "\n")
  writeLines(fasta,paste0(ImmcantationFolder,"8_PostIgBlastFilter/",file,"_IGH_sequence_before_deduplication_to_search_membrane_secreted.fasta"))
  
}
```

##### Align against IMGT CHS and M references

Final strategy kept :  align the full constant region from CH1 to CHS or M/M1+M2 exons (artificialy spiced sequences dowloaded from IMGT GENE-DB in 2024-09-25)

```{bash,eval=F}
## conda activate pRESTO

cd ${LongRead_dir}

#List file

  echo $file

echo "Align and store as tsv file for parsing"

blastn -task megablast -query "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/8_PostIgBlastFilter/${file}_IGH_sequence_before_deduplication_to_search_membrane_secreted.fasta" -subject PATH/20240925_IMGT_artificialy_Spliced_Constant_IGH_secreted_or_membrane.fasta -outfmt 6 -out "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/8_PostIgBlastFilter/${file}_IGH_sequence_before_deduplication_to_search_membrane_secreted_BlastnAligned_fullArtificialySplicedConstant.tsv"

blastn -task megablast -query "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/8_PostIgBlastFilter/${file}_IGH_sequence_before_deduplication_to_search_membrane_secreted.fasta" -subject PATH/20240925_IMGT_artificialy_Spliced_Constant_IGH_secreted_or_membrane.fasta -outfmt 0 -out "${LongRead_dir}Immcantation/8_PostIgBlastFilter/${file}_IGH_sequence_before_deduplication_to_search_membrane_secreted_BlastnAligned_fullArtificialySplicedConstant_HumanReadable.txt"
```

##### Tag Database with membrane or secreted form

Tag each reads in the AIRR databse after chimeric read filtering with the results of the alignment of Blastn.

Multiple quality checks of the alignment to choose the best alignment and with high confidence on the membrane or secreted form assignment :

- Alignment score : if there is a unique alignment with a best score / vs multiple alignment with the same best score  
- Ambiguous alignment : if multiple best alignment are coming from different gene (e.g. IGHA1 and IGHG1, then impossible to choose the correct one. If there are multiple alignment of the same gene but different allele, then it is OK) or different isotype (e.g. different gene : IGHG4 and IGHG4A but the isotype is the same, then choose a correct alignment) but from the same form (only CHS alignment, then it is a secreted form) or from both form then it is impossible to choose the correct form  
- Complete vs partial vs incomplete alignment of the constant reference sequence : if the constant reference sequence is aligned on the read from the 1st base to the last base of the reference, then it is a complete alignment (most probably a correct alignment, then assignment of membrane or secreted form is confident). If there is an alignment with less than 6 bases (max 5 bases) not aligned in the start or the end of the reference sequence, then it is a partial alignment (probably correct too). Finaly, if there are too many bases of the reference sequence that are not aligned, especially in the end, it is an incomplete alignment and it is impossible to infer if it is a secreted or membrane form.  

```{r,eval=FALSE}
SampleId <- Anonym_table$SpatialVDJ_id

IDmatch <- Anonym_table$SpatialGEX_id
names(IDmatch) <- SampleId

# Open a file connection for writing a log file ##un comment if needed
sink(paste0("PATH/Processed_3rdRun/Immcantation/","pipeline_log/","R_LongReads_IgBlast_Alignment_IGH_membrane_or_secreted_Form.log"), append = FALSE, type = c("output"))

  print("Start processing of Long read aligned with IgBlast")
  Sys.time()
  
  #add space in the log
  print("\n")
  print("\n")

for(file in FileID){
  
  print(file)
  
  # path of Igblast quality filtered database
  file_path <- paste0(ImmcantationFolder,"8_PostIgBlastFilter/",file,"_igblast-db_quality_filter-allFilter_germ-pass_chimeric-filter.tsv")
  
  # Load airr 
  airr <- read_rearrangement(file_path)
  
  ## Print AIRR DB info after chimeric filters
  TotalIGHinput <-sum(airr$locus=="IGH")
  print(paste0("Total IGH reads in input (after chimeric filter) : ",TotalIGHinput))
  
  # Read Blastn output from full length constant sequence membrane or secreted form alignment against IGH reads
  BlastnResult <- read.delim(paste0(ImmcantationFolder,"8_PostIgBlastFilter/",file,"_IGH_sequence_before_deduplication_to_search_membrane_secreted_BlastnAligned_fullArtificialySplicedConstant.tsv"),header = F)
  colnames(BlastnResult)<-c("qseqid", "sseqid", "pident", "length", "mismatch", "gapopen", "qstart", "qend", "sstart", "send", "evalue", "bitscore")
  
  # Get the Gene and Label from the aligned sequence
  BlastnResult$Gene_aligned <- gsub("\\*.*","",sapply(base::strsplit(BlastnResult$sseqid,split = "\\|"),function(x)x[[2]]))
  
  BlastnResult$Label_aligned <- sapply(base::strsplit(BlastnResult$sseqid,split = "\\|"),function(x)x[[5]])
  
  BlastnResult$Form <- ifelse(grepl("CHS",BlastnResult$Label_aligned),yes = "Secreted",no = "Membrane")
  
  
  # Get the original query seq (Long read) id
  BlastnResult$sequence_id <- sapply(base::strsplit(BlastnResult$qseqid,split = "\\|"),function(x)x[[1]])
  
  ## Print the number of IGH read with at least 
  Num <- length(unique(BlastnResult$sequence_id))
  Prop <- round((Num/TotalIGHinput)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Number of IGH read with at least 1 alignment of constant full length reference : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  
  # Get the length of the full length constant reference sequence
  BlastnResult$RefSeq_length <- as.numeric(gsub("nt","",sapply(base::strsplit(BlastnResult$sseqid,split = "\\|"),function(x)x[[7]])))
  
  ## Proportion of RefSeq_aligned
  BlastnResult$RefSeq_aligned_prop <- BlastnResult$length/BlastnResult$RefSeq_length
  
  
  #In airr, for each IGH read, compute the number of bases after the end of j alignment and seq_length
  airr$seq_length <- nchar(airr$sequence)
  ##End_seq_length : after j end
  airr$End_seq_length <- airr$seq_length - airr$j_sequence_end
  
  
  # Merge
  BlastnResult <- base::merge(BlastnResult,airr[,c("sequence_id","j_sequence_end","seq_length","End_seq_length")],by= "sequence_id",all.x = T)
  
  # Compute proportion of end_seq_aligned
  BlastnResult$End_seq_aligned_prop <-BlastnResult$length/BlastnResult$End_seq_length
  
  # Compute proportion of End_seq and Ref_seq
  BlastnResult$Ratio_EndSeq_RefSeq_length <- BlastnResult$End_seq_length/BlastnResult$RefSeq_length
  
  
  # Split by read id
  BlastnResult <- split(BlastnResult,BlastnResult$sequence_id)
  
  # For each read, take only one best alignment which should be : 
  ## Unique best match (read_table$bitscore==max(read_table$bitscore)+ The begining and the end of the constant ref are aligned (sstart==1 and send==RefSeq_length)
  ### If end of ref seq is not aligned : incomplete form
  ## If multiple match, then if all the multiple match are only allele from the same gene and same form (secreted of membrane), then choose randomly one.
  ### If different forms : ambiguous form
  ### If end of ref seq is not aligned : incomplete form
  ### If multiple gene but the isotype is the same (e.g. IgG1 and IgG2 CHS form both), then took the corresponding form with the IgBlast alignment and the form is secreted form
  
  BlastnResult_bestMatch <- lapply(BlastnResult,function(read_table){
    tmp <- read_table[read_table$bitscore==max(read_table$bitscore),] # sub by max score
    tmp$iso <- substr(tmp$Gene_aligned,1,4)
    tmp$IgblastIso <- gsub(".v_sequence_start.*","",gsub(".*isotype=","",tmp$qseqid))
    if(nrow(tmp)==1){
      # Test if send (end of the alignment of ref seq) is equal to refseq_length (ie start and end of ref seq are fully aligned against the original long read )
      if((tmp$RefSeq_length == tmp$send) & (tmp$sstart == 1)){
        tmp$Best_alignment <- "Unique_&_complete"
        return(tmp)
      }else{
        #Start is 1 but End is less than 6 bases from the end of refseq (2 codon) : 
        if((tmp$sstart == 1) & ((tmp$RefSeq_length - tmp$send)<6)){
          tmp$Best_alignment <- "Unique_&_End_partial<6b"
          return(tmp)
        }else if((tmp$sstart < 6) & (tmp$RefSeq_length == tmp$send)){
          tmp$Best_alignment <- "Unique_&_Start_partial<6b"
          return(tmp)
        }else if((tmp$sstart < 6) & ((tmp$RefSeq_length - tmp$send)<6)){
          tmp$Best_alignment <- "Unique_&_Start&End_partial<6b"
          return(tmp)
        }else{
          tmp$Best_alignment <- "Unique_&_incomplete"
          return(tmp)
        }
      }
    }else{
      #If multiple alignment, verify that there are not only all from the same gene or isotype
      if((length(unique(tmp$Label_aligned))==1)){
        if((length(unique(tmp$Gene_aligned))==1)){
          # if at least one with complete form choose one : tmp$RefSeq_length == tmp$send
          if(any((tmp$RefSeq_length == tmp$send)  & (tmp$sstart == 1))){
            tmp <- head(tmp[(tmp$RefSeq_length == tmp$send) & (tmp$sstart == 1),],n=1)
            tmp$Best_alignment <- "Multiple_&_UniqueGene_&_complete"
            return(tmp)
          }else{
            #Start is 1 but End is less than 6 bases from the end of refseq (2 codon) : 
            if(any((tmp$sstart == 1) & ((tmp$RefSeq_length - tmp$send)<6))){
              tmp <- head(tmp[(tmp$sstart == 1) & ((tmp$RefSeq_length - tmp$send)<6),],n=1)
              tmp$Best_alignment <- "Multiple_&_UniqueGene_&_End_partial<6b"
              return(tmp)
            }else if(any((tmp$sstart < 6) & (tmp$RefSeq_length == tmp$send))){
              tmp <- head(tmp[(tmp$sstart < 6) & (tmp$RefSeq_length == tmp$send),],n=1)
              tmp$Best_alignment <- "Multiple_&_UniqueGene_&_Start_partial<6b"
              return(tmp)
            }else if(any((tmp$sstart < 6) & ((tmp$RefSeq_length - tmp$send)<6))){
              tmp <- head(tmp[(tmp$sstart < 6) & ((tmp$RefSeq_length - tmp$send)<6),],n=1)
              tmp$Best_alignment <- "Unique_&_Start&End_partial<6b"
              return(tmp)
            }else{
              tmp <- head(tmp,n=1)
              tmp$Best_alignment <- "Multiple_&_UniqueGene_&_incomplete"
              return(tmp)
            }
          }
        }else{
          #Test unique iso (e.g. : IGHG2 CHS with same score than IGHG3 CHS, then OK)
          if((length(unique(tmp$iso))==1) & any(tmp$Gene_aligned %in% unique(tmp$IgblastIso))){
           tmp <- tmp[tmp$Gene_aligned %in% unique(tmp$IgblastIso),] # filter on IgBlast gene
            if(any((tmp$sstart == 1) & (tmp$RefSeq_length == tmp$send))){
              tmp <- head(tmp[(tmp$sstart == 1) & (tmp$RefSeq_length == tmp$send),],n=1)
              tmp$Best_alignment <- "Multiple_&_UniqueIso_&_complete"
              return(tmp)
            }else{
              #Start is 1 but End is less than 6 bases from the end of refseq (2 codon) : 
              if(any((tmp$sstart == 1) & ((tmp$RefSeq_length - tmp$send)<6))){
                tmp <- head(tmp[(tmp$sstart == 1) & ((tmp$RefSeq_length - tmp$send)<6),],n=1)
                tmp$Best_alignment <- "Multiple_&_UniqueIso_&_End_partial<6b"
                return(tmp)
              }else if(any((tmp$sstart < 6) & (tmp$RefSeq_length == tmp$send))){
                tmp <- head(tmp[(tmp$sstart < 6) & (tmp$RefSeq_length == tmp$send),],n=1)
                tmp$Best_alignment <- "Multiple_&_UniqueIso_&_Start_partial<6b"
                return(tmp)
              }else if(any((tmp$sstart < 6) & ((tmp$RefSeq_length - tmp$send)<6))){
                tmp <- head(tmp[(tmp$sstart < 6) & ((tmp$RefSeq_length - tmp$send)<6),],n=1)
                tmp$Best_alignment <- "Multiple_&_UniqueIso_&_Start&End_partial<6b"
                return(tmp)
              }else{
                tmp <- head(tmp,n=1)
                tmp$Best_alignment <- "Multiple_&_UniqueIso_&_incomplete"
                return(tmp)
              }
            } 
          }else{
            tmp <- head(tmp,n=1)
            tmp$Best_alignment <- "Multiple_&_AmbiguousGene"
            return(tmp)
          }
        }
      }else{
        tmp <- head(tmp,n=1)
        tmp$Best_alignment <- "Multiple_&_AmbiguousForm"
        return(tmp)
      }
    }
  })
  BlastnResult_bestMatch <- Reduce(rbind,BlastnResult_bestMatch)
  
  
  ## Merge back with AIRR DB
  ### rename colname before merging with AIRR
  NewNames <- c("sequence_id"="sequence_id",
                "sseqid"="c_imgtref_call",
                "Label_aligned"="c_imgtref_label",
                "Form"="c_imgtref_form",
                "length"="c_align_length", 
                "mismatch"="c_align_mismatch", 
                "gapopen"="c_align_gapopen",
                "pident"="c_identity",
                "bitscore"="c_score",
                "evalue"="c_support",
                "qstart"="c_sequence_start",
                "qend"="c_sequence_end",
                "sstart"="c_imgtref_start",
                "send"="c_imgtref_end",
                "RefSeq_length"="c_imgtref_length",
                "RefSeq_aligned_prop"="c_imgtref_aligned_ratio",
                "Best_alignment"="c_imgtref_call_status")
  BlastnResult_bestMatch <- BlastnResult_bestMatch[,names(NewNames)]
  colnames(BlastnResult_bestMatch)<- NewNames
  
  airr <- base::merge(airr,BlastnResult_bestMatch,by="sequence_id",all.x = T)
  
  # Convert c_imgtref_form according to c_imgtref_call_status in secreted/membrane or NA/Ambiguous/Incomplete
  airr$c_imgtref_form <- ifelse(is.na(airr$c_imgtref_form),yes = "Form_NA",
                                no = ifelse(grepl("Ambiguous",airr$c_imgtref_call_status),yes = "Ambiguous",
                                no = ifelse(grepl("incomplete",airr$c_imgtref_call_status),yes = "Incomplete",
                                no = airr$c_imgtref_form)))
  
  
  #### Compute per isotype
  # Table<-round((table(airr$c_imgtref_form,airr$isotype)/rep(colSums(table(airr$c_imgtref_form,airr$isotype)),each=5))*100,0)
  TableCount <- table(airr[airr$locus=="IGH","c_imgtref_form"])
  TableCount_homogeneized <- c(Ambiguous=0,    Form_NA=0, Incomplete=0,   Membrane=0,   Secreted=0)
  TableCount_homogeneized[names(TableCount)]<- TableCount
  
  Num <- TableCount_homogeneized[["Secreted"]]
  Prop <- round((Num/sum(TableCount_homogeneized))*100,2)
  print(paste0("IGH READ - Secreted form : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  Num <- TableCount_homogeneized[["Membrane"]]
  Prop <- round((Num/sum(TableCount_homogeneized))*100,2)
  print(paste0("IGH READ - Membrane form : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  Num <- TableCount_homogeneized[["Ambiguous"]]
  Prop <- round((Num/sum(TableCount_homogeneized))*100,2)
  print(paste0("IGH READ - Ambiguous form : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  Num <- TableCount_homogeneized[["Incomplete"]]
  Prop <- round((Num/sum(TableCount_homogeneized))*100,2)
  print(paste0("IGH READ - Incomplete form : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  Num <- TableCount_homogeneized[["Form_NA"]]
  Prop <- round((Num/sum(TableCount_homogeneized))*100,2)
  print(paste0("IGH READ - Form_NA form : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  

  #########
  # Some check plot
  Check_df <- airr[airr$locus=="IGH",]
  Check_df_melt <- data.frame(table(Check_df[,c("isotype","c_imgtref_form")]))
  Prop<-table(Check_df[,c("isotype","c_imgtref_form")])/rowSums(table(Check_df[,c("isotype","c_imgtref_form")]))
  Prop<- data.frame(Prop)
  colnames(Prop)<-c("isotype","c_imgtref_form","Prop")
  Check_df_melt <- base::merge(Check_df_melt,Prop,by = c("isotype","c_imgtref_form"))
  Check_df_melt$isotype <- factor(Check_df_melt$isotype,levels = c("IGHM","IGHD","IGHG3","IGHG1","IGHA1","IGHG2","IGHG4","IGHE","IGHA2","IGH_NA"))
  
  # Compute Prop of reads with unique or multiple best alignment with RefSeq_aligned_Prop >/<=0.95
    Plot1 <- ggplot(Check_df_melt,aes(x=isotype,y=Freq,fill=c_imgtref_form))+
    geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity")+
    theme_bw()+
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(Form_NA="grey",Ambiguous="#B15928",Incomplete="#6A3D9A",Secreted="#A6CEE3",Membrane="red")[levels(Check_df_melt$c_imgtref_form)])+
    #scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = base_breaksLog1p(),labels = prettyNum)
    labs(title = "Alignment of constant region - READS ",subtitle = file,x=NULL,y="Number of read",fill=NULL)+
      guides(fill = "none")
    
    Plot2 <- ggplot(Check_df_melt,aes(x=isotype,y=Prop,fill=c_imgtref_form))+
    geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity")+
    theme_bw()+
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(Form_NA="grey",Ambiguous="#B15928",Incomplete="#6A3D9A",Secreted="#A6CEE3",Membrane="red")[levels(Check_df_melt$c_imgtref_form)])+
    #scale_y_continuous(trans = "log1p", breaks = base_breaksLog1p(),labels = prettyNum)
    labs(title =  NULL,x=NULL,y="Proportion of read",fill="Form")

    
    ### Save - NB: not the final plot included in the Supplementary figure. Plot need to be at clonotype level after deduplication, not reads levels (as it is here)
    ggsave(filename = paste0(res_folder,"03_IgBlast/",file,"_REDS_IGH_beforeDeduplication_ConstantRegion_Membrane_secreted_form.pdf"),
           plot = Plot1/Plot2,
           width = 7,height = 5)
    
    ## Save the AIRR DB with the IGH constant secreted vs membrane form tag
    write_rearrangement(airr,file=paste0(ImmcantationFolder,"8_PostIgBlastFilter/",file,"_igblast-db_quality_filter-allFilter_germ-pass_chimeric-filter_igh-form.tsv"))

  #add space in the log
  print("\n")
  print("\n")
  
}
  
sink()


```


### Collapse duplicates 

Collapse duplicates reads in unique clonotypes (unique VDJ sequence according to Sofou et al, 2023)

```{r,eval=F}

SampleId <- Anonym_table$SpatialVDJ_id

IDmatch <- Anonym_table$SpatialGEX_id
names(IDmatch) <- SampleId

# Open a file connection for writing a log file ##un comment if needed
sink(paste0("PATH/Processed_3rdRun/Immcantation/","pipeline_log/","R_LongReads_IgBlast_Alignment_CollapseDuplicates.log"), append = FALSE, type = c("output"))

  print("Start processing of Long read aligned with IgBlast")
  print("Collapse duplicates group :")
  paste(c("v_gene","j_gene","cdr3","isotype","c_imgtref_form","productive","sb"),collapse = ",")
  
  Sys.time()
  
  #add space in the log
  print("\n")
  print("\n")


for(file in FileID){
  
  print(file)
  
  # Do not need to adapt from here - path of Igblast quality filtered database
  file_path <- paste0(ImmcantationFolder,"8_PostIgBlastFilter/",file,"_igblast-db_quality_filter-allFilter_germ-pass_chimeric-filter_igh-form.tsv")
  
  # Load airr 
  airr <- read_rearrangement(file_path)
  
  Input <- nrow(airr)
  
  # Filter reads based on spots within tissue areas
  ## Get list of spots in tissue (before filtering for mt gene / 300 genes min)
  TissuePosition <- read.csv(paste0("PATH/",IDmatch[[file]],"/outs/spatial/tissue_positions.csv"),header = TRUE)
  TissuePosition$barcode <- gsub("-1","",TissuePosition$barcode)
  
  ## Load list of barcode in Seurat object after filtering spots with too low gene diversity (300 features) and 30% mitochondrial genes
  SeuratSCT <- readRDS(paste0("PATH/",IDmatch[[file]],"/RDS/",IDmatch[[file]],"_seurat_postfilter_sct.rds"))
  FilteredQualSpot <- base::setdiff(TissuePosition$barcode[TissuePosition$in_tissue==1],gsub("-1","",colnames(SeuratSCT))) ## list of spot which are not in Seurat post filter object and which are in tissue (1) are the spots filtered for low quality (>300 genes | <30% mito genes)
  
  TotalSpot <- sum(TissuePosition$in_tissue==1)
  print(paste0("Number of spot in tissue : ",TotalSpot))
  
  Num <- length(FilteredQualSpot)
  Prop <- round((Num/TotalSpot)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Number of quality filtered spots (<300 features | >30% mito genes) : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  #### Count reads in spots outside tissue or filtered
  print(paste0("Total reads in input (before collapse duplicates) : ",Input))
  
  Num <- sum(airr$sb %in% TissuePosition$barcode[TissuePosition$in_tissue==0])
  Prop <- round((Num/Input)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Reads in spot outside tissue area : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  Num <- sum(airr$sb %in% FilteredQualSpot)
  Prop <- round((Num/Input)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Reads in quality filtered spot : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  
  ## Filter reads in incorrect spot
  
  airr <- airr[airr$sb %in% TissuePosition$barcode[TissuePosition$in_tissue==1],]
  airr <- airr[!(airr$sb %in% FilteredQualSpot),]
  
  Num <- nrow(airr)
  Prop <- round((Num/Input)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Total reads in spot within tissue area (after filter) : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  #Create a sb_umi column by concatenating sb and umi
  airr$sb_umi <- paste(airr$sb,airr$umi,sep = "_")
  
  # Start Collapse Duplicates
  
  print(paste("Start collapseDuplicates for file :",file))
  
  t1 <- Sys.time()

  # I - First De-dup : De-deduplication of different read with same SB_UMI (PCR bias)
  ## First step : TAG to identify clonotypes which are unique VDJ sequence alignment sharing c("v_gene","j_gene","cdr3","isotype","c_imgtref_form","productive") but can be in different spot and different umi
  ## Collapse group : same v_gene, j_gene, CDR3, isotype, productive,c_imgtref_form
  collapse_groups <- c("v_gene","j_gene","cdr3","isotype","c_imgtref_form","productive")
  ######### TAG GROUP (same collapse_group : same v,j,cdr3,isotype,form )
  airr <- airr %>% 
      mutate(v_gene=getGene(v_call), j_gene=getGene(j_call)) %>% 
      group_by(.dots=collapse_groups) 
  CollapseGroup=group_indices(airr)
  airr <- airr %>%
    ungroup %>%
    mutate(CollapseGroupId=paste0("GroupId",CollapseGroup)) ## Add a groupID column
  ## Collapse duplicate with dry=TRUE to tag collapsing group and notably add a collapse_id column but do not deleted the sequences
  ## Allow to compute the number of reads per SB_UMI with different collapse_ID, ie : One collapse_ID dominant (max number) which is the TRUE one, the other are coming from PCR/Sequencing error and should be remooved
  airr <- airr %>%
    group_by(.dots=collapse_groups) %>%
    do({
    collapsed_data <- collapseDuplicates(., id = "sequence_id", seq = "sequence_alignment", text_fields = NULL, num_fields = NULL, seq_fields = NULL, add_count = FALSE, ignore = c("N", "-", ".", "?"), sep = ",", dry = TRUE, verbose = F)
    collapsed_data$collapse_id <- paste0("CollapseId",as.character(collapsed_data$collapse_id)) # Convert collapse_id to character type
    collapsed_data
  }) %>%
      ungroup() 
  
  # Add GroupID in collapse_id column by concatenating GroupId and collapse_id
  airr$collapse_id <- paste(airr$CollapseGroupId,airr$collapse_id,sep = "_")
  
  print("Ambiguous clonotype reads identification")
  print(table(airr$collapse_class,airr$collapse_pass))
  print(round(table(airr$collapse_class,airr$collapse_pass)/sum(table(airr$collapse_class,airr$collapse_pass)),2))

  Num <- sum(airr$collapse_class != "ambiguous")
  Prop <- round((Num/nrow(airr))*100,2)
  print(paste0("Total reads with not ambiguous clonotype defined : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  airr <- airr[airr$collapse_class != "ambiguous",]
  
  ## Remove incorrect reads with same SB_UMI but different collapse_ID (would generate different clonotypes which are incorrect)
  UniqueSB_UMIgroups <- unique(airr$sb_umi)
  res <- lapply(UniqueSB_UMIgroups,function(SB_UMI){
    ## Sub all reads with same SB_UMI group
    tmp <- airr[airr$sb_umi %in% SB_UMI,]
    ## Table the number reads in that group for each collapse ID group (there should be only one. If there are multiple, then only one is the true and should be kept : the one counted the most without ambiguity)
    reads_count <- table(tmp$collapse_id)
    if(length(reads_count)==1){
      return(data.frame(sequence_id=tmp$sequence_id,PCRbias="OK"))
    }else{
      #Multiple collapse ID, what is the one counted the most
      MaxCount <- max(reads_count)
      if(sum(reads_count==MaxCount)>1){
        ## Multiple group of reads with the same max (e.g. all counted 1 time, impossible to choose the right one, then remoove all the group of read) 
        return(data.frame(sequence_id=tmp$sequence_id,PCRbias="MultipleMax"))
      }else{
        ##Only one collapse group is counted the most, then keep this one, the other are removed
        CollapseIDMax <- names(reads_count)[reads_count==MaxCount]
        tmp$PCRbias <- ifelse(tmp$collapse_id==CollapseIDMax,yes = "OK",no = "PCR_Sequencing_error")
        return(data.frame(tmp[,c("sequence_id","PCRbias")]))
      }
    }
  })
  res <- Reduce(rbind,res)
  
  ### Merge back and remove the error
  airr <- base::merge(airr,res,by = "sequence_id",all = T)
  airr$PCRbias <- factor(airr$PCRbias,levels = c("OK","MultipleMax","PCR_Sequencing_error"))
  
  print("Number of reads found with multple clonotype in a SB_UMI group reads - To filter")
  print("NB : Count each SB_UMI with multiple group of collapse sequence - keep only the reads in the Max")
  print(table(airr$PCRbias))
  print(round(table(airr$PCRbias)/sum(table(airr$PCRbias))*100,2))
  
  Num <- sum(airr$PCRbias == "OK")
  Prop <- round((Num/nrow(airr))*100,2)
  print(paste0("Total reads after filter PCR_sequencing error in SB_UMI groups : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  airr <- airr[airr$PCRbias == "OK",]
  
  # Keep the collapse_id as clonotype_id (same VDJ alignment isotype and constant form accross all SB)
  airr$clonotype_id <- airr$collapse_id
  
  ##### Collapse duplicate with dry=F and add_count=T to collapse seq and count 
  #############@
  airr <- airr %>%
    group_by(.dots=c(collapse_groups,"sb_umi")) %>%
    do(collapseDuplicates(.,id = "sequence_id",seq = "sequence_alignment", text_fields = c("sequence_id","sb","umi","sb_umi"),num_fields = NULL, seq_fields = NULL,add_count = TRUE,ignore = c("N", "-", ".", "?"), sep = ",",dry = F,verbose = F)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(read_count = as.numeric(collapse_count)) %>% # convert in numeric if necessary and rename in read_count
    select(-CollapseGroupId, -collapse_id, -collapse_class, -collapse_pass, -collapse_count, -PCRbias) #remove unecessary column
  

  BeforeDedupSBUMI <- Num
  Num <- nrow(airr) #after dedup SB
  Prop <- round((Num/BeforeDedupSBUMI)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Total sequences after dedup umambiguous clonotypes & PCR bias corrected reads per SB_UMI : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  ##########################################################################################
  # II - Second De-dup : De-deduplication of different read with same SB but different UMI (True duplicates : different RT event from the same SB). If there are different collapse if within one groupID, then it is possible because in one spot, SB, there can be multiple cells with different sequences ...)
  ## Collapse group : same v_gene, j_gene, CDR3, isotype, productive,c_imgtref_form, sb
  collapse_groups <- c("v_gene","j_gene","cdr3","isotype","c_imgtref_form","productive","sb")
  # Collapse duplicate with dry=F and add_count=T to collapse seq and count 
  ### WITHOUT  UMI to collapse group by SB
  ############# 
  airr <- airr %>%
    group_by(.dots=collapse_groups) %>%
    do(collapseDuplicates(.,id = "sequence_id",seq = "sequence_alignment", text_fields = c("sequence_id","sb","umi","sb_umi"),num_fields = "read_count", seq_fields = NULL,add_count = TRUE,ignore = c("N", "-", ".", "?"), sep = ",",dry = F,verbose = F)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(umi_count = as.numeric(collapse_count)) %>% # convert in numeric if necessary and rename in read_count
    select( -collapse_count) #remove unecessary column

  BeforeDedupSB <- Num
  Num <- nrow(airr) #after dedup SB
  Prop <- round((Num/BeforeDedupSB)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Total sequences after dedup umambiguous clonotypes & PCR bias corrected reads per SB : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
 ##########################################################################################
  t2 <- Sys.time()
  TimeDiff<-t2-t1
  print("Collapse duplicate sequences run time")
  print(TimeDiff)
  
  ######### filter 2 UMI
  Num <- length(unique(airr$clonotype_id))
  print(paste0("Number of unique clonotypes (in all different spots): ",Num))
  
  # Compute the number of unique UMI per clonotype ID (sum the unique UMI in different SB)
  UniqueUMI <- tapply(airr$umi_count,airr$clonotype_id,sum)
  
  ## Filter clonotype with only 1 UMI counted in the all slide - too low confidence ... Many are coming from PCR error of the highly counted clonotypes ..........
  TableUMI <- table(ifelse(UniqueUMI>1,"More_Than_1UMI","Only1"))
  Num <- TableUMI[["More_Than_1UMI"]]
  Prop <-round((Num/sum(TableUMI))*100,2)
  print(paste0("Number of clonotype with more than 1 UMI : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  Clonotype_to_keep <- names(UniqueUMI)[UniqueUMI>1]
  airr <- airr[airr$clonotype_id %in% Clonotype_to_keep,]
  
  # Re-order the final repertoire table by clonotype ID and SB, and umi count
  airr <- airr[order(airr$locus,airr$clonotype_id,airr$umi_count,decreasing = T),]

  # Print number of unique final clone per chain
  
  TableChain <- table(airr[!duplicated(airr$clonotype_id),]$locus)
  Total <- sum(TableChain)
  
  print(paste0("Total CLONOTYPE after all quality filter : ",Total))
  
  Num<-ifelse(test = "IGH" %in% names(TableChain),yes = TableChain["IGH"],no = 0)
  Prop <- round((Num/Total)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Total CLONOTYPE after all quality filter - IGH : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  Num<-ifelse(test = "IGK" %in% names(TableChain),yes = TableChain["IGK"],no = 0)
  Prop <- round((Num/Total)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Total CLONOTYPE after all quality filter - IGK : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  Num<-ifelse(test = "IGL" %in% names(TableChain),yes = TableChain["IGL"],no = 0)
  Prop <- round((Num/Total)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Total CLONOTYPE after all quality filter - IGL : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  Num<-ifelse(test = "TRA" %in% names(TableChain),yes = TableChain["TRA"],no = 0)
  Prop <- round((Num/Total)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Total CLONOTYPE after all quality filter - TRA : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  Num<-ifelse(test = "TRB" %in% names(TableChain),yes = TableChain["TRB"],no = 0)
  Prop <- round((Num/Total)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Total CLONOTYPE after all quality filter - TRB : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  Num<-ifelse(test = "TRG" %in% names(TableChain),yes = TableChain["TRG"],no = 0)
  Prop <- round((Num/Total)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Total CLONOTYPE after all quality filter - TRG : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))
  
  Num<-ifelse(test = "TRD" %in% names(TableChain),yes = TableChain["TRD"],no = 0)
  Prop <- round((Num/Total)*100,2)
  print(paste0("Total CLONOTYPE after all quality filter - TRD : ",Num," (",Prop,"%)"))

  
  pal <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11,name = "Paired")
  pal <- c(IGL=pal[[1]],
           IGK=pal[[2]],
           IGH=pal[[6]],
           TRA=pal[[4]],
           TRB=pal[[8]],
           TRG=pal[[3]],
           TRD=pal[[7]])
  
  
  ## Plot chain percentage

  TablePlot <- c("IGH"=0,"IGK"=0,"IGL"=0,"TRA"=0,"TRB"=0,"TRG"=0,"TRD"=0)
  TablePlot[names(TableChain)] <-TableChain 
  
  pdf(paste0(res_folder,"03_IgBlast/",file,"_CLONE_after_all_quality_filter_Chain_proportion.pdf"),width = 5, height = 5) # Save a pie plot in pdf
    pie(TablePlot, 
        labels = paste0(names(TablePlot)," n=",TablePlot), 
        main = "Chain proportion after all quality filter", 
        col = pal)
  dev.off() # close the pdf device  
    

  ## Write final repertoire table with SpotList, NbSpots, NbReadInSpots and NbUniqueUMI columns
  write_rearrangement(airr,file=paste0(ImmcantationFolder,"8_PostIgBlastFilter/",file,"_igblast-db_quality_filter-allFilter_germ-pass_chimeric-filter_igh-form_Collapse-clonotype-split-SB_Min-2-UMI.tsv"))

  #keep some memory
  ## remove all object but c("FileID","ImmcantationFolder","RawReadFolder","res_folder")
  rm(list=setdiff(ls(),c("FileID","IDmatch","ImmcantationFolder","res_folder","collapse_groups")))
  gc()
  
  
  print("\n")
  print("\n")
}

sink()
```

```{r,eval=FALSE}
    UniqueClonotype[is.na(UniqueClonotype)] <-0 # replace NA by 0 count
    UniqueClonotype<-data.frame(UniqueClonotype)
    UniqueClonotype$IG <- rowSums(UniqueClonotype[,c("IGH","IGK","IGL")]) # sum all IG unique clonotype

    #Same for IGH isotypes
    UniqueClonotypeIGH<-tapply(airr$clonotype_id,airr[,c("sb","isotype")],function(clonotype)length(unique(clonotype)))
    UniqueClonotypeIGH <- UniqueClonotypeIGH[,grepl("IGH",colnames(UniqueClonotypeIGH))] ## Keep only IGH isotypes
    UniqueClonotypeIGH[is.na(UniqueClonotypeIGH)] <-0 # replace NA by 0 count
    UniqueClonotypeIGH<-data.frame(UniqueClonotypeIGH)
    
    #Same for IGH form
    UniqueClonotypeForm<-tapply(airr$clonotype_id,airr[,c("sb","c_imgtref_form","locus")],function(clonotype)length(unique(clonotype)))
    UniqueClonotypeForm <- UniqueClonotypeForm[,,"IGH"] ## Keep only on IGH clonotypes
    UniqueClonotypeForm[is.na(UniqueClonotypeForm)] <-0 # replace NA by 0 count
    UniqueClonotypeForm<-data.frame(UniqueClonotypeForm)
    UniqueClonotypeForm<-UniqueClonotypeForm[,c("Membrane","Secreted")] # keep only clear form
    colnames(UniqueClonotypeForm)<-c("BCR","Antibody")#rename
    
    #bind both df
    UniqueClonotype<-cbind(UniqueClonotype,UniqueClonotypeIGH[rownames(UniqueClonotype),],UniqueClonotypeForm[rownames(UniqueClonotype),])
    ##rename column
    colnames(UniqueClonotype)<-paste(colnames(UniqueClonotype),"clonotype",sep = "_")
    
  # ORder IGH iso
    Order <- c("IGHM","IGHD","IGHG3","IGHG1","IGHA1","IGHG2","IGHG4","IGHE","IGHA2","IGH_NA")
    
    # retrieve all SB in the Seurat object.
    ## If 0 clonotype in the SB, then 0 rather than NA again / prepare to have all Chain/isotypes for all slides
    metadata<-matrix(rep(rep(0,times=length(colnames(combined))),
                         times=ncol(UniqueClonotype)),
                     nrow=length(colnames(combined)))
    metadata<-data.frame(row.names = colnames(combined),metadata)
    colnames(metadata)<-paste(c("IG","IGK","IGL","IGH",Order,"BCR","Antibody"),"clonotype",sep = "_")
    for(col in colnames(UniqueClonotype)){
      #fill the unified metadata
      metadata[rownames(UniqueClonotype),col]<-UniqueClonotype[,col]
    }
    #Add to Seurat Metadata
    combined <- AddMetaData(object= combined,
                            metadata = metadata)
    
    # same but in log scale (ln (x+1))
    metadata_ln <- log1p(metadata)
    colnames(metadata_ln)<-paste(colnames(metadata_ln),"log",sep = "_")
    combined <- AddMetaData(object= combined,
                            metadata = metadata_ln)

airr$sampleid<-factor(airr$sampleid,levels = Anonym_table$Anonym_id)
```

## Generate a clonotype table from Meylan et al, 2022

First, generate a table with in row each clonotypes in the 12 Visium datasets (not splited at the level of spatial barcode as it is done in SpatialVDJ) and all information about theses clonotypes (nucleotides and AA sequences, number of counts in a sample, the sample of origin, the isotype, the spots where the clonotype is found, number of mutations ...). This is done by reproducing Maxime Meylan script [03_spatial_clonotype_analysis.R](https://github.com/maximemeylan/Meylan_et_al_2022/blob/main/03_spatial_clonotype_analysis.R) first part generating the final clonotype table (until line 187, before plots).
NB : for the MiXCR run on raw fastq files (not provided : see Meylan et al, 2022), the script is available on Maxime Meylan github [03_mixcr_for_visium.sh](https://github.com/maximemeylan/Meylan_et_al_2022/blob/main/03_mixcr_for_visium.sh). This script was not run again (used the mixcr output from Maxime Meylan ...).

I used the same anonymized code as in Meylan et al, 2022, Immunity (a_.., b_..., c_...). From [GEO repo](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE175540), the samples are named ccRCC tumor frozen_a... (MiXCR on frozen samples only, not FFPE samples). 
Note : From the GEO repo, the anonymized names match the Table S1 but there is one mistake in TableS2, sample a_3 is indicated as a_4 (but no Visium was performed on a_4 sample as indicated in TableS1, and no data for a_4 are available in GEO; only data for a_3, for which number of clonotypes in my table match with what is indicated in S2 for a_4...)

```{r,eval=FALSE}
# Load slide list of Visium data from MaxMey (cf Immunity | Github MaxMey)
Visium_MaxMey_matchId <- "" # Not shared
Visium_MaxMey_matchId <- Visium_MaxMey_matchId[Visium_MaxMey_matchId$Spatial.transcriptomics %in% "Frozen",]

slide_list <- Visium_MaxMey_matchId$Id_Visium_file # not anonym id (not provided due to patient privacy requirement)

Anonymize_id <- Visium_MaxMey_matchId$ano_ID
names(Anonymize_id) <- Visium_MaxMey_matchId$Id_Visium_file # to get the corresponding ano_ID in the loop

#spatial clonotype analysis
clonotype_list <- NULL
#import 10X spatial barcodes

for(x in slide_list){
        print(x)
        barcodes <- read.csv(paste0("PATH/",x,"/outs/raw_feature_bc_matrix/barcodes.tsv.gz"),header = F)
        barcodes <- gsub(pattern = "-1",replacement = "",barcodes$V1)
        dir_fastq <- paste0("PATH/",x,"/")
        
        temp <- read.csv(paste0(dir_fastq,x,"repertoire.clonotypes.ALL.txt"),sep = '\t')
        
        temp$sampleid <- Anonymize_id[[x]] # anonymize here
        
        temp$spatial_barcodes <- NA
        temp$nspots <- NA
        temp$type <- substr(temp$allVHitsWithScore, start = 1, stop = 3)
        clust <- makeCluster(12)
        clusterExport(clust, c("dir_fastq","barcodes","temp","x"))
        res <- parLapply(cl=clust,temp$cloneId,function(clone){
                #for(clone in temp$cloneId){
                fastq_clone_path <- paste(dir_fastq,"clones_fastq/",x,"_reads_cln",clone,"_R1.fastq.gz",sep = "")
                if(file.exists(fastq_clone_path)){
                        r1 <- read.csv(fastq_clone_path,sep = "\n")[c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE), ]
                        res <-NULL
                        for(barcode in barcodes){
                                if(any(grepl( barcode, r1, fixed = TRUE))){
                                        res <- c(res,paste0(barcode,"-1"))
                                        temp[temp$cloneId==clone,"spatial_barcodes"] <- paste0(unlist(res),collapse = ',')
                                        temp[temp$cloneId==clone,"nspots"] <- length(unique(unlist(res)))
                                }
                        }
                }
                temp[temp$cloneId==clone,]
        })
        temp <- data.frame(do.call(rbind, res))
        clonotype_list[[x]] <- temp
        #annotate seurat object
        IGH_barcodes <- unique(unlist(strsplit(temp[temp$type=="IGH","spatial_barcodes"],split = ",")))
        spot_info <- sapply(IGH_barcodes, function(bc){
                bc_cdr3 <- temp[grep(bc, temp$spatial_barcodes),"aaSeqImputedCDR3"]
                counts <- length(unique(bc_cdr3))
                max_length  <- max(nchar(bc_cdr3),na.rm = T)
                average_length  <- mean(nchar(bc_cdr3),na.rm = T)
                temp_igh <- temp[temp$type=="IGH",]
                major_isotype <- unique(substr(temp_igh[grep(bc, temp_igh$spatial_barcodes),"allCHitsWithScore"],start = 1,stop =4))
                major_isotype_names <- paste0(names(table(major_isotype)),collapse = "")
                return(list("unique_counts_IGH"= counts,
                            "average_cdr3_length_IGH"= average_length,
                            "max_cdr3_length_IGH"= max_length,
                            "isotypes"= major_isotype_names))
        })
        # for(info in rownames(spot_info)){
        #         spatial_list[[x]] <- AddMetaData(object= spatial_list[[x]],
        #                                          metadata = unlist(spot_info[info,]),
        #                                          col.name = info)
        # } # comment because the script is only used to generate the clonotype table / not annotate visium
        #IGL 
        IGL_barcodes <- unique(unlist(strsplit(temp[temp$type=="IGL","spatial_barcodes"],split = ",")))
        spot_info_igl <- sapply(IGL_barcodes, function(bc){
                bc_cdr3 <- temp[grep(bc, temp$spatial_barcodes),"aaSeqImputedCDR3"]
                counts <- length(unique(bc_cdr3))
                max_length  <- max(nchar(bc_cdr3),na.rm = T)
                average_length  <- mean(nchar(bc_cdr3),na.rm = T)
                temp_igl <- temp[temp$type=="IGL",]
                major_isotype <- unique(substr(temp_igl[grep(bc, temp_igl$spatial_barcodes),"allCHitsWithScore"],start = 1,stop =4))
                major_isotype_names <- paste0(names(table(major_isotype)),collapse = "")
                return(list("unique_counts_IGL"= counts,
                            "average_cdr3_length_IGL"= average_length,
                            "max_cdr3_length_IGL"= max_length,
                            "isotypes_IGL"= major_isotype_names))
        })
        # for(info in rownames(spot_info_igl)){
        #         spatial_list[[x]] <- AddMetaData(object= spatial_list[[x]],
        #                                          metadata = unlist(spot_info_igl[info,]),
        #                                          col.name = info)
        # }# comment because the script is only used to generate the clonotype table / not annotate visium
}
clonotype_merged <- Reduce(rbind,clonotype_list)

## generate table 
unique_CDR3 <- sapply(unique(clonotype_merged$type),function(x) nrow(clonotype_merged[clonotype_merged$type==x,]))
counts_CDR3 <- sapply(unique(clonotype_merged$type),function(x) sum(clonotype_merged[clonotype_merged$type==x,"cloneCount"]))


#mutation analysis 
# targetFrom | targetTo | targetLength | queryFrom | queryTo | mutations | alignmentScore
clusterExport(clust, "stri_split")
clusterExport(clust, "str_count")
mutations <- parApply(cl = clust,clonotype_merged,1, function(x){
        #compute J alignments
        J_alignment <- x["allJAlignments"]
        #J_target_length <- as.numeric(stri_split(str = J_alignment,fixed='|')[[1]][3])
        #may be biaised by length of RNA fragment mapping
        J_target_length <- as.numeric(stri_split(str = J_alignment,fixed='|')[[1]][5]) - as.numeric(stri_split(str = J_alignment,fixed='|')[[1]][4])
        J_subs <- str_count(J_alignment,pattern = "S")
        J_ins <- str_count(J_alignment,pattern = "I")
        J_del <- str_count(J_alignment,pattern = "D")
        J_all <- (J_subs+J_ins+J_del) / J_target_length
        #compute V alignments
        V_alignment <- x["allVAlignments"]
        V_alignment <- gsub(";",",",V_alignment)
        #take first alignment
        V_alignment <- unlist(stri_split(str = V_alignment,fixed=','))
        #remove ""
        V_alignment <- V_alignment[!V_alignment == ""]
        V_qual <- sapply(stri_split(str = V_alignment,fixed="|"),function(splitst) as.numeric(splitst[length(splitst)]))
        
        vquerylengths <- sapply(V_alignment,function(align){
                align_split <- stri_split(str = align,fixed='|')[[1]]
                if(any(align_split!="")){
                        V_query_length <- as.numeric(align_split[5]) - as.numeric(align_split[4])
                }else{
                        0
                }
        })
        V_query_length <- sum(vquerylengths)
        
        #quality and length filter
        V_alignment <- V_alignment[V_qual > 0 ] 
        #quality to return 
        V_qual <- sapply(stri_split(str = V_alignment,fixed="|"),function(splitst) as.numeric(splitst[length(splitst)]))
        
        #if no aligment match quality
        V_target_length <- as.numeric(nchar(x["targetSequences"]))
        if(identical(character(0),V_alignment)){
                return(c('J_target_length' =J_target_length,
                         "J_mutation_freq"=NA,
                         "J_mutation_perc"=NA,
                         'V_target_length' =V_target_length,
                         "V_query_length"=NA,
                         "V_mutation_freq"=NA,
                         "V_qual"=NA,
                         "V_mutation_perc"=NA))
        }else{
                V_subs <- str_count(x["allVAlignments"],pattern = "S")
                V_ins <- str_count(x["allVAlignments"],pattern = "I")
                V_del <- str_count(x["allVAlignments"],pattern = "D")
                V_all <- (V_subs+V_ins+V_del) / V_query_length
                return(c('J_target_length' =J_target_length,
                         "J_mutation_freq"=(J_subs+J_ins+J_del),
                         "J_mutation_perc"=J_all,
                         'V_target_length' =V_target_length,
                         "V_query_length"=V_query_length,
                         "V_mutation_freq"=(V_subs+V_ins+V_del),
                         "V_qual"=median(V_qual),
                         "V_mutation_perc"=V_all))
        }
})
stopCluster(clust)
mutations <- t(mutations)
clonotype_spatial_mut_Immunity12ccRCC <- cbind(clonotype_merged,mutations)
```

```{r}
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))+
    labs(title = NULL,
         x=NULL,
         y="Number of clonotype+1",
         color="Tumor ID",
         shape="Tumor sample")

## only Form
P2 <- ggplot(Clono_Total[Clono_Total$Form=="IGH form",],aes(x=variable,y = value+1))+
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0,fill="#00BFC4")+
    geom_point(size=0.8)+
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10",breaks = base_breaksLog10(),labels = prettyNum)+
  scale_shape_manual(values = 18)+
    # scale_fill_manual(values = pal)+
    theme_classic()+
  # facet_wrap(~Form,drop = T)+
  stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif",label.x.npc = "center")+
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))+
    labs(title =NULL,
         x=NULL,
         y="Number of clonotype+1",
         color="Tumor ID",
         shape="Tumor sample")

# patchwork
Plot<-(P1|P2)+plot_layout(axes = "collect",guides = "collect",widths = c(7,1))
ggsave(plot = Plot,
       filename = paste0(res_folder,"Figure2D_VisiumV1_vs_SpatialVDJ_Clonotype_Count_perChain_V2.pdf"),
       width = 6,
       height = 3)
```

## Figure 2F - Spatial Clonotypes for all chains

```{r}
#to iterate on
Var <- paste(c("IG","IGK","IGL","IGH",Order,"BCR","Antibody"),"clonotype",sep = "_")
Var <- Var[Var!="IGH_NA_clonotype"]#remove IGH_NA

for(file in Anonym_table$Anonym_id){
  ## subset combined to individual file (distribution per file)
  seurat_sub <- suppressWarnings(subset(combined,subset = file_id %in% file))
    Plot<-list()
  for(var in Var){
    #All spots
    p1 <- SpatialPlot(seurat_sub,
                      image.alpha = 0,
                      features = var ,
                      crop = T,
                      pt.size.factor = 2 )
    
    # keep only the plot from the slide ...
    p1<- p1[[which(levels(seurat_sub$file_id)==file)]] 

      maxx<-max(seurat_sub@meta.data[,var])
      if(maxx<10){
        p1 <- p1+ 
            # scale_fill_viridis(option = "F",direction =-1 )+
        scale_fill_viridis(option = "F",labels=prettyNum,direction =-1 ,na.value="grey")+
        theme(  axis.title.x=element_blank(),
            axis.text.x=element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
            axis.title.y=element_blank(),
            axis.text.y=element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
            # legend.text = element_text(size = 4),    # Adjust legend text size
            #   legend.title = element_text(size = 4),# Adjust legend title size
            #   legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),# adjuste size of legend box
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.background = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
        labs(fill = gsub("_","\n",var),title = NULL)  # Change legend name
        
        if(maxx==0){
          p1<-p1+
            scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey",high = "grey")
        }
        
      }else{
       p1 <- p1 + 
            # scale_fill_viridis(option = "F",direction =-1 )+
        scale_fill_viridis(option = "F",direction =-1 ,trans = "log",breaks=base_breaksLog10(10),labels=prettyNum,na.value="grey")+
        theme(  axis.title.x=element_blank(),
            axis.text.x=element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
            axis.title.y=element_blank(),
            axis.text.y=element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
            #legend.text = element_text(size = 4),    # Adjust legend text size
    # legend.title = element_text(size = 4),# Adjust legend title size
    # legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),# adjuste size of legend box
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            panel.background = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
        labs(fill = gsub("_","\n",var),title = NULL)  # Change legend name
      }
      
    ggsave(plot = p1,
           filename = paste0(res_folder,file,"_",var,"_SpatialPlot_AllSpot.pdf"),
           width = 4,height = 5)
    Plot[[var]]<-p1
  }# End var loop

  #save a compressed plot to save space
  patch<-wrap_plots(Plot,nrow = 3)
  # patch_raster <- patch +
  #     ggrastr::rasterise(geom_point(), dpi = 300)
  ggsave(plot = patch,
           filename = paste0(res_folder,file,"_","Patchork_IG","_SpatialPlot_AllSpot.pdf"),
           width = 10,height = 8)
  
  ## Without IgE
  ##### THIS IS THE MAIN Figure 2F (for slide SP_LHD6US)
  patch<-wrap_plots(Plot[setdiff(names(Plot),"IGHE_clonotype")],nrow = 2)
    ggsave(plot = patch,
           filename = paste0(res_folder,file,"_","Patchork_IG","_SpatialPlot_AllSpot_noIGHE.pdf"),
           width = 15,height = 6)
} # Rename the one for SP_LHD6US as Figure2F_......
```
